[]

Anekārthadhvanimañjarī, vocabulary. He quotes
Rudra, Gaṅgādhara, Dharaṇi, Ratnakośa. Cop.
103. L. 746. He is quoted by Raghunandana.
 Ūṣmaviveka. L. 351. Quoted by Ramānātha.
 Tattvacandrikā Kirātārjunīyaṭīkā L. 2140. He
quotes the C. by Prakāśavarṣa.

गदसिंह son of Śivasiṃha:
 Kirātārjunīyaṭīkā. See the C. by Rāmacandra.

गदा Paribhāṣenduśekharaṭīkā by Bhairavamiśra.
 --by Vaidyanātha Pāyaguṇḍe.

गद composed in 1554:
 Sampradāyakuladīpikā.
गदाधर father of Govinda (Kuṇḍamārtaṇḍa 1692). Bhr. 770.

गदाधर son of Rāmeśvara, son of Vedeśvara, son of
Caṇḍeśvara, was father of Vidyādhara, father of
Ratnadhara, father of Jagaddhara (Mālatīmādhavaṭīkā,
etc.). Oxf. 136^a. L. 1981.
गदाधर father of Mādhavamiśra (Bhedadīpikā). L. 1879.

गदाधर father of Mukundapriya, grandfather of Rāmā-
nanda (Kāśīkhaṇḍaṭīkā). W. p. 145.

गदाधर son of Viṣṇu, father of Sadāśiva of the Daśa-
putra family (Liṅgārcanacandrikā). L. 1944.

गदाधर younger brother of Viṣṇu Bhaṭṭa, uncle and
guru of Kṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa (Padārthacandrikāvilāsa).
Hall p. 75.
गदाधर poet. Skm.

गदाधर a medical writer. Quoted by Bhāvamiśra Oxf.
311^b, by Vaidyavācaspati Oxf. 314^b.
Kṛtyakalpadruma. Oudh 1876, 12.

Grahayāgāyutahomalakṣahomakoṭihomasiddhi. W.
p. 349.
